sections.heading: MINOR IN WRITING STUDIES
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - English and Writing Studies

Completion of first-year requirements, including 0.5 course from Writing 1000F/G, Writing 1031F/G or Writing 1035A/B with a grade of at least 70%; or 0.5 course from Writing 2101F/G, Writing 2111F/G, Writing 2130F/G, or Writing 2131F/G with a grade of at least 65%; or special permission of the Department.
2.0 courses in Writing at the 2200 level or above. Speech 2001 may be counted toward this 2.0 requirement.
Note: Other courses may be substituted with permission of the Undergraduate Program Director (Writing).
Note: The Minor in Writing Studies may be combined with the Certificate in Professional Communication. The Minor in Writing Studies may not be combined with the Certificate in Writing.
